RE3_codec v0.13 section-8 report
================================
The original 100-EMD corpus sweep found:
- 74 section-8 blocks of 4 bytes containing 00000000
- 26 section-8 blocks of 20 bytes
- the 20-byte blocks collapsed to two repeated binary signatures (15 + 11)

v0.13 does NOT assign an unproven semantic struct. Use re3c_read_section() to
preserve or inspect the bytes losslessly.
